statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: A TCP endpoint MUST implement the basic congestion control algorithms slow start, congestion avoidance, and exponential backoff of RTO to avoid creating congestion collapse conditions (MUST-19).

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: An endpoint MAY implement such alternative algorithms provided that the algorithms are conformant with the TCP specifications from the IETF Standards Track as described in RFC 2914, RFC 5033 [7], and RFC 8961 [15] (MAY-18).
actions: implement alternative congestion control algorithms conformant with RFC 2914, RFC 5033, and RFC 8961

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: A TCP endpoint SHOULD implement ECN as described in RFC 3168 (SHLD-8).
actions: implement Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN) per RFC 3168
